name: Jiangsu Hengxing New Material
summary: Jiangsu Hengxing New Material Technology Co., Ltd is an international enterprise specializing in the research, development, and production of chemical substances. The company's diverse product line includes various organic compounds such as ketones, acids, esters, alcohols, aldehydes, ethers, and acid anhydrides. Its main operations are headquartered in Jiangsu, China.
